newsitem.title: USA: Seattle mayor proposes $80-$90 mln street bond.
newsitem.headline: Seattle mayor proposes $80-$90 mln street bond.

text.p: Seattle Mayor Norm Rice plans to propose an $80 million to $90 million bond measure to pay for street repairs, his office said on Thursday.
If approved by the city council and then by voters in November, the bond would increase property taxes on a $170,000 home by as much as $85 per year.
"We have some serious funding issues on transportation," said Rebecca Hale, Rice's spokesperson. "We're going to need to come up with some long-term stable funding source."
Rice is expected to bring his bond proposal to the city council in the coming weeks.
